ITEM 1 | Long flat strip, reddish-brown with darker caramelized edges and glossy sheen, slightly curled at ends, firm with some rendered fat look, about 11 cm long and 2.5 cm wide at widest, lying diagonally across upper-left of plate, footprint roughly 8% of plate, about 0.5 cm thick | 18

ITEM 2 | Scrambled pale yellow egg, soft, moist-looking clumps with fine crumbly texture and slight sheen, irregular pieces about 1-2 cm each, mounded in center-right of plate beside the strip, footprint roughly 12% of plate, about 1.5 cm tall | 35

ITEM 3 | Shredded orange cheese, bright orange strands about 3-5 cm long, thin and loose, scattered over and among the egg and partly over the strip, dry-looking with slight sheen, footprint roughly 8% of plate, about 0.5 cm thick in clumps | 12
